purpose: Cat-only Onyx asset package with a real-world calibrated blank-room viewer. Room, cat scale, physics mass, grid, and reference markers are expressed in real measurements.

fur_and_appearance.texture_pass: rendering-fix pass after documented screenshot audit
fur_and_appearance.body_material_strategy: One opaque double-sided MeshStandardMaterial is assigned to the Cat mesh. The FBX audit confirmed the Cat geometry has only one active group and it uses material index 0 (skin).
fur_and_appearance.highlight_fix: Removed runtime normal/roughness maps from the body material and compressed bright albedo outliers to stop silver-white streaks on the back, shoulders, head and spine.
fur_and_appearance.paw_and_ear_fix: The incorrectly UV-localized purple paw/ear/nose composite is no longer used at runtime. The source detail maps remain preserved for future model-specific UV work.
fur_and_appearance.black_fur_rule: Runtime fur is neutral-black and highlight-compressed so the coat reads black rather than brown/grey while retaining visible strand texture.
fur_and_appearance.coverage_fix: Body material is forced transparent=false, opacity=1, alphaTest=0, depthWrite=true, depthTest=true, DoubleSide, with frustum culling disabled for animated meshes.
fur_and_appearance.eye_visibility_fix: The supplied green-yellow iris was expanded into corrected sphere maps and given capped emissive support so both eyes remain visibly green-yellow without white bloom.

movement_behavior_from_original_code.animation_update_rule: Walk mixer advances only while idle == false in the original game loop.
movement_behavior_from_original_code.orientation_rule: Cat rotation.y is set to rotay; physics quaternion is deliberately not copied back to the cat so it lands on its legs.
movement_behavior_from_original_code.physics_collision_units: meters; half-width from 11 in chest reference, 0.225 m vertical half-extent to align the calibrated FBX root/paws with the floor, half nose-to-tail-base body length; tail excluded

viewer.room: 12 ft W × 14 ft D × 8 ft H measured calibration room; clear interior dimensions, 4.5 in walls, 6 in floor slab
viewer.cat_loader: FBXLoader with audited one-group Cat material replacement and corrected direct-open runtime textures
viewer.movement: Ammo.js + ThirdPersonControls-style movement matching original values
third_party_runtime: Three.js r111 modules required by FBXLoader
Ammo.js from the supplied SmellyCat source
viewer.direct_open_assets: viewer-assets.js embeds cat.fbx plus only the runtime render-fix fur and eye maps.
viewer.camera_controls: Pointer-drag orbit with full 360-degree yaw, top-down and underside vertical range, pointer capture to prevent sticky dragging, wheel zoom, and R reset.
viewer.measurement_guides: 1 ft floor grid, stronger 5 ft grid lines, 1 ft wall ruler, 5 ft 4 in user-height reference, 14 in Onyx shoulder marker, 38 in Onyx overall-length floor bar; M toggles visibility
viewer.scale_note: The calibration room is a relative reference room, not a claim about the user’s real room dimensions.

realism_pass.goal: Make Onyx read as a realistic domestic shorthair with selective Maine Coon structural influence rather than a fluffy purebred caricature.

morphology.forequarters: ~10.5% localized shoulder/ribcage widening plus a smaller lower-chest expansion
morphology.abdomen: localized low primordial-pouch deformation behind the ribcage; topline remains sleek
morphology.waist: slight narrowing behind ribcage to preserve long lean silhouette
morphology.head: small broadening of head and muzzle only
morphology.coat: existing sleek opaque black rendering preserved; no floof geometry added

realism_pass.whiskers: 12 procedural whiskers parented to Nose bone; 10 white/pale and 2 charcoal, curved with TubeBufferGeometry.
realism_pass.secondary_motion: subtle post-mixer spine counter-motion and tail sway while walking; original FBX remains the primary gait.
research_basis: open-source quadruped rig architecture research on GitHub

cat_shape_pass.tum_tum: Re-targeted to the actual abdominal underside band rather than low leg vertices; stronger downward/outward pouch with slight rearward hang and runtime sway while walking.
cat_shape_pass.body: Broader shoulders/chest retained; previous waist-pinching pass removed; slight mid-body substance added so Onyx reads stocky-sleek rather than skinny.
cat_shape_pass.eyes: Visible eye spheres moved forward ~4.2 FBX object units and enlarged modestly to reduce the sunken-eye look while retaining green-yellow irises.
cat_shape_pass.nose: Nose-weighted vertices get a small feline tip/bridge protrusion and narrowed tip; procedural rounded-triangle satin-black nose plane follows the Nose bone.
cat_shape_pass.mouth: Mouth-weighted lower muzzle/chin receives independent volume plus subtle philtrum and curved W-shaped mouth creases parented to Mouth bone.
cat_shape_pass.whiskers: 14 curved, asymmetrical whiskers; 12 white/pale and 2 charcoal.
cat_shape_pass.coat: Color textures are now explicitly decoded as sRGB before gamma output, preventing near-black albedo from being lifted into charcoal gray.
cat_shape_pass.research_note: Sims 3/4 pet sculpting informed separating weight/mass from muscle/forequarter structure instead of globally scaling the cat.

real_world_scale_pass.fbx_scale_derivation: Raw nose-front to tail-base longitudinal span is ~7.702 FBX mesh units. The Cat node carries ~100x internal scale. 23.5 in / (7.702 × 100) gives root scale ≈ 0.000775 when one world unit is one meter.

calibrated_model_checks.paw_to_shoulder_region: approximately 15 in in bind-pose geometry, within the supplied 13-15 in target band when interpreted at the shoulder surface rather than neck/head vertices
calibrated_model_checks.tail: bone chain plus modeled tip falls in approximately the supplied 13-16 in target region

human_reference.wheelchair: custom-sized to user; photos/videos used as a visual relationship check only
human_reference.non_inference_rule: No wheelchair width, user body width, seated height, or reach was fabricated from weight. Exact chair/body dimensions should be entered only if measured values are supplied.

calibration_room.status: explicit measured relative/test room, not the user’s claimed real room size
